tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur rig bsdus pa mkha' 'gro lnga yi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpañtsa ḍā kī nī bh+yaḥ rdo rje 'chang mtshungs bla ma dang / /dpal ldan ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /mkha' 'gro lnga la gus btud nas/ /de nyid bsgom pa'i cho ga bshad/ /'di la gsum gyi/ dang po gang zag ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa sngags kyi lam la gus pa dang / spyod lam dal zhing zab pa dang rgya che ba rig pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes pa de nyid bcu rig pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnas ni/ dur khrod dang / chu 'gram dang / shing gcig dang / ri bo dang / tshang tshing la sogs pa me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang pos byugs pa'o/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor la/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang / ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la/ skyed rdzogs/ bzlas pa gsum gyi/ dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis so/ /dang po la tshogs bsags pa dang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ stan 'jam po nang tshangs can la rdo rje skyil krung gis nye bar 'dug nas/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor sngon du byas te/ sems can gyi don du dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems sngon du btang nas/ rang thugs kyi mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i thugs kar/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ zla phyed sogs kyi gdan la/ dbus dang phyogs gzhan du nyi ma/ shar du zla ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ am̐ kham̐/ bsams pa las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dmigs la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/

/sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /sems can kun gyi thams cad khyod/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs su rtogs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdang bas mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang / /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nga rgyal mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /nga rgyal thams cad zad mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /'dod chags rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chags pas mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /'dod chags thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ /ser sna rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba phrag dog mnan gzigs nas/ /phrag dog thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /bdun gyi rgyal po chen po ste/ /thams cad gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas phyag bya/ de nas dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ gau rī ri bong can gyi snod thogs pa dang / tsau rī rak+ta'i snod/ bait+tā lī chu'i snod/ ghasma rī sman/ puk+ka sī rdo rje'i snod/ sha ba rī ro'i snod thogs pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī rnge'u chung brdung zhing / ḍoṃ bi nīs mgrin pa nas 'khyud de mnyes par byas par bsams la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan pa 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag

/de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces brjod la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang / bde ba dang dus nam du'ang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la mnyam pa'i sems thob par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad snang yang dpyad na dmigs su med pa gzugs brnyan ltar gsal gdab/ de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ de'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing kha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs kun tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol du 'phros pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/

bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa mi g.yo ba lta bur dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam pa'i dbus su 'khor lo'i nang gi phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad ma mthar byed dmar po pad ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ mer dbyug sngon can dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ bden bral du mi g.yo ba ral gri 'dzin pa/ rlung du stobs po che rtse gsum 'dzin pa ste/ bzhi ni nag po'o/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po g.yas pa na chos kyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa ste/ phyogs bzhi bden bral rlung / steng gi khro bo rnams ni sbrul rgyan dang stag lpags can/ gzhan rnams ni rin po che'i rgyan dang lha'i na bza' can/ thams cad kyang sku thung zhing gsus pa che ba/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing / mig dmar la zlum pa/ sna tshogs pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyi klu'i zhags pa thogs shing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /rgyas par byed na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gshin rje gshed la rnam snang / pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ dbyug sngon can dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la rdor sems/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/ 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor bas dgra bgegs thams cad gtub pa dang / khro bo rnams zhal phyir bstan nas gnod pa thams cad bzlog par bsam zhing / na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra muṅga ra hastā ya tsaṇ+ḍa lā k+ṣe pa ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ mahā daṇ+ḍa dha ra bi bi dha su rā su rā marda na bhū tān+nir+m+ma tha hūm̐ phaṭ/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ hu lu hu lu mahā pad+ma a mṛ tī ku ru mahā bi ṣān āḥn maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na moḥbadz+ra kro dha ya mahā daṃṣ+ṭ+rot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya badz+ra san+to ha dar+pā ya/ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥn maḥs man+ta bud dhe bh+yo/ oṃ ya ma daṇ+ḍā ya nī lā ya nī la daṇ+ḍa ya/ tu ru tu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sarba duṣ+ṭān mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo a tsa la kā ṇa/ tseṭ+ṭā tseṭ+ṭā/ moṭ+ṭā moṭ+ṭā/ tuṭ+ṭa tuṭ+ṭa/ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhe bh+yo/ na mo mahā ba lā ya uts+tshu ṣ+ma kro dha rā dzā ya sar+b+ba nā gā nāṃ hṛ da yaṃ tā ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dhar+m+mā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pra tra/ oṃ bi ma la oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ sar+b+ba yan+t+ra man+t+ra mū la karma/ ban dha naṃ/ tā ḍā na/ kī la naṃ bā/ ma ma kṛ te/ ye na ke na/ tsita kṛ taṃ tata sar+b+baṃ tu/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa rnams ci nus bzlas pa'i rjes su/ gang dag bla ma dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sems can la sdang ba'i sems dang / gdug pa'i sems dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pas/ 'khrul 'khor dang / byad stems dang / ngan sngags kyi sbyor ba la sogs pa sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i dgra bgegs de dag gi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig gal te zhi bas gdul bar mi nus pa de dag gi lus ngag yid bcing ba dang /

mthu dang stobs brlag pa dang / des bsgrubs pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa de dag de nyid la phyir bzlog pa dang / de'i stong grogs byed pa'i srung ma de dag kyang / de nyid la gnod pa'i sbyor ba mdzod cig ces dam bcol bya/ bsdu na dbu rgyan rang chas mar bsgoms la skye mched byin rlabs nas/ bzlas pa'i bar ma byas kyang rung ngo / /de gnyis ka'i mthar dpag tshad brgya'i nang du 'jug pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhās byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po smad zhum zhing stod yangs pa'i nang du/ paṃ las pad ma/ a las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i stengadu raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i stengadu laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo las byung ba'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi ba spu'i bu ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags pas/ 'byung bzhi zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin/ nag ljang / dmar/ ser/ dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu la rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ steng nas rin po che'i shar bu las 'phyang ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas spras shing / de'i steng du mda' yab pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyis mdzes par byas la/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo na rdo rje rin po che phyed pas spras pa/ sgo rnams kyi steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa'i rtser/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang /

gdugs dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang / sgo dang sgo khyud kyi grwa rnams su rdo rje rin po ches spras pa/ phyi rol du kha khyer la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ kha khyer nas rdo rje ra ba la thug pa'i bar gyi sa gzhi thams cad rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas dpag tu med pas gang ba/ gzhal yas khang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba sngon po'i dbus su/ phyogs bzhi'i mtha' nas lha snam cha chen re re bor ba'i dbus su/ mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbus dang phyogs bzhir gnas pa las/ dbus kyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rtag pa'i dkyil 'khor du dkar ljang dmar ser sngo/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du ser ljang dmar sngo dkar/ gar gyi dbang phyug la dmar ljang sngo ser dkar/ rta mchog la ljang sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang / dra ba dra phyed rin chen shar bu mda' yab rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dbus phyur bu rta babs dang bcas pa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa'i/ dbus kyi lha snam gyi kha dog sngar dang 'dra ba'i dbus zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa can/ shar gyi lha snam shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba'i dbus zlum po'i dbyibs can/ lho'i shar dkar lho sngo nub dmar byang ljang ba'i dbus rin po che'i cha dgu pa'i dbyibs can/ nub kyi shar dkar lho ser nub sngo byang ljang ba'i dbus su pad ma'i dbyibs can/ byang gi shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang sngo ba'i dbus su gru gsum gyi dbyibs can rnams kyi dbus su/ pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ tshangs pa ser po spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ dbang po kham ser rdo rje 'dzin pa/

khyab 'jug nag po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ drag po dkar po rtse gsum 'dzin pa rnams kyi steng du/ rnam snang la zla ba/ gzhan rnams la nyi ma/ lha mo rnams kyi gnas su zla ba dang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ gzhal yas khang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin yin no/ /zhes nga rgyal bzung ste/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag dang po'o/ /de nas dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ ā li bcu drug pa phrag gnyis pa lnga zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa ā lis mtshan pa me long ye shes su mos te/ de la 'od 'phros sangs rgyas kyi mtshan so gnyis ā li'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ sngar gyi yi ge la thim pas rgyas par bsgom/ de'i steng du kā li so bzhi ya ra la wa ḍa dha drug bsnan pas bzhi bcu phrag gnyis yongs su gyur pas zla ba gru gsum kā lis mtshan pa mnyam nyid ye shes su mos/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad brgyad cu kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngar gyi yi ge la thim pas rgyas par bsgom/ de dag gi steng du dbus su hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba can/ phyogs bzhir/ oṃ tram̐ am̐ kham̐ rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i/ 'khor lo rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams bsgoms te/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes su mos pa bya/ de dag las 'od 'phros pa las rigs lnga dpag tu med pa 'phros pa rnams kyis sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te zla ba rdo rje la thim pas ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes su mos/ de yongs su gyur pa las mkha' 'gro lnga'i gzugs su gyur pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su mos te/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog dkar po phyag mtshan dang zhal la sogs pa 'og nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bsgom/ de nas yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la a/

sbu gu'i nang du phaṭ kyis mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs te hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐/ nor bu'i rtse mor oṃ gyis mtshan pa bsgom/ oṃ pad+ma su khā dhā ra mahā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya ka kha ga mu khe ka ra swa nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes bskul te yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par mos te/ o+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo yin no zhes nga rgyal gzung / de nas gtso bo lnga'i lus la gnas pa'i rlung bcu phyir song ba'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe sna g.yon pa nas zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ste/ dbang gi gnas su thig le brgyad brgyad du gyur pa zhu ba las rang rang gi 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon du gyur/ de las lha mo so so'i skur gyur nas gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gam̐ las gau rī dkar mo g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor tsam̐ las tsau rī ser mo g.yas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ nub tu bam̐ las ro langs ma dmar mo g.yas rdo rje'i lcags sgrog byang du gham̐ las za phod ma ljang gu g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pam̐ las puk+ka sī nag mo g.yas byang sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor sham̐ las ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas ri rab/ lho nub tu lam̐ las gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas me thab/ nub byang du ḍam̐ las g.yung mo ljang gu g.yas rlung gis skyod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rtag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du sam̐ las rkaṃ pa ma nag mo g.yas rkaṃ pa/

lhor pām̐ las zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa/ nub tu bam̐ las dol zlum ma dmar mo g.yas nya rgya zlum po/ byang du am̐ las lcags kyu ma ljang gu g.yas pas lcags kyu/ dbang ldan du pam̐ las me tog ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis me tog gi za ma tog mer dham̐ las bdug pa ma dud ka phyag gnyis kyis bdug spos kyi snod/ bden bral du dam̐ las mar me ser mo phyag gnyis kyis mar me'i snod/ rlung du gam̐ las byug pa ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du sam̐ las nyi lag ma dkar mo g.yas pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ lhor dam̐ las mar me ma dmar mo g.yas mar me'i sdong snod/ nub tu ram̐ las rin chen sgrol ma ser mo g.yas rin po che/ byang du tām̐ las glog lag ma ljang gu g.yas glog gi phreng ba/ dbang ldan du lam̐ las sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje khu tshur rked par 'jog pa/ mer gam̐ las glu ma ser mo rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul/ bden bral du nam̐ las gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis gar byed pa'i tshul/ rlung du ham̐ las bzhad pa mo dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis khu tshur kha 'gram du 'jog pa bzhad pa'i tshul/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi shar du pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po g.yas pad ma/ lhor dham̐ las chos 'byung ma ser mo g.yas chos 'byung / nub tu s+pham̐ las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog byang du sham̐ las 'khyud ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pa'i tshul can/ dbang ldan du bam̐ las gling bu ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis gling bu/ mer bam̐ las pi wam̐ ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis kyis pi wam̐/ bden bral du mam̐ las rdza rnga ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga kha gcig pa brdung ba'i tshul/ rlung du sam̐ las rnga chen ma ljang gu mgrin par rnga btags nas phyag gnyis kyis brdung ba'i tshul/ rta rgyal gyi shar du tām̐ las sgo lcags ma dkar mo g.yas sgo lcags/

lhor kam̐ las lde skyog ma ser mo g.yas lde skyog nub tu kam̐ las sgo glegs ma dmar mo g.yas pas sgo/ byang du pam̐ las gos 'dzin ma ljang gu g.yas gos/ dbang ldan du lam̐ las spyan ma dkar mo g.yas spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo/ mer mam̐ las mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ bden bral du pam̐ las gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ rlung du tām̐ las sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ gtso mo'i mkha' nas gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du am̐ las lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ lhor pām̐ las zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa/ nub tu s+pham̐ las lcags sgrogs ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog byang du gham̐ las dri mas dril bu ma ljang gu g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan ma smos pa thams cad sdigs mdzub can yin la/ thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas sku la brgyan pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba'o/ /de nas yab yum rjes chags kyi mes snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang / thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥyig dmar po/ 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis kyi nang du chud pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ yab yum gnyis ka'i zhal nas zhugs/ lha mo'i pad+mar 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu bas thig le'i gzugs can du gyur/ de'i 'od kyi mthus yab yum gnyis ka'ang zhu ba'i gzugs can 'od 'bar bar gyur pa la/ dbang ldan nas bsams te/ rang rang gi mtshams kyi lha mo gzhis rim pa bzhin/ khyod ni zhe sdang rdo rje yongs skyong pa/ /thugs dag chos ni shin tu rnam dag pas/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la myur du gzigs/

/rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /khyod ni gti mug rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /dag pa'i sku yi chos kyi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /ri khrod ma ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /khyod ni 'dod chags rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /gsung dag legs par so sor rtog pa yis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /gtum par ldan pa bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad yongs skyong ba/ /gzugs kun nan tan thams cad mnyam nyid kyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /ḍoṃ bi bdag la mgon pos myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las sad de sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran nas/ rang rang gi sa bon las phyag mtshan du gyur nas skur bzhengs pa ni/ dbus su hūm̐ mām̐ las phyag mtshan rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ mām̐ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las thugs kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum du bzhengs pa'i yab sku mdog nag po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ lhag ma rnams nag pa/ spyi bor rdo rje nag pos brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu gwa pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mo thal kha/ mi dmar po/ seng ge sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha ser po/ chu'i lha dkar po/ me lha dmar po/ rlung gi lha ljang gu/ zla ba dkar po/ nyi ma dmar po/ gshin rje sngon po/

nor bdag ser po 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pas skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /shar gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su/ oṃ lam̐ las 'khor lo dang gri gug oṃ lam̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar po rtsa zhal dkar g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ spyi bor chos kyi 'khor los brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na/ rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin ma ka ra/ sbrul gyi rgyal po/ ru sbal/ klu lhag ma can dkar po/ ngang skya/ ri bong / g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na lho sbal/ ha la ha la'i sbrul/ kha chu ste glang po/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ri/ lho sgo'i byi ba/ g.yag ri dwags bla ba/ bzhad rnams 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo ste/ gzhan rnams thams cad sngar dang 'dra ba las zla ba'i 'od can no/ /lhor tram̐ tām̐ las rin po che dang gri gug tram̐ tām̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ser po ser nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ spyi bor rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na/ bya ka ran ta/ ngur ba ser po/ lug tsa ko ra/ bye khra/ hor khra/ 'ol pa/ nya khra/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na/ stobs kyi rgyu ljang gu/ dung skyong dang rigs ldan ser po/ pad+ma dang / pad bzangs can dkar/ 'jog po ser/ nor rgyas dmar/ mtha' yas sngon po 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o/ /nub kyi dbus su am̐ pam̐ las pad ma dang gri gug am̐ pam̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/

spyi bor pad+ma dmar pos brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na/ dom/ bya rgod/ bse ru/ ba men/ stag spre'u/ chu srin/ spye lcang / g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na/ khwa ta/ 'ug pa/ chu skyar/ seng ge/ bya khyung dmar po/ ra/ sha ba/ phag 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba ste/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o/ /byang gi dbus su kham̐ tām̐ ljang gu las ral gri dkar po dang gri gug kham̐ tām̐ gyis mtshan pa gyur pa las rta rgyal rtsa zhal ljang gu rta gdong can g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ spyi bor ral gri dkar pos brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na/ gza' lag ser po mda'/ phur bu ser po mchod sdong / mjug rings nag po ral gri dang klu zhags/ sgra gcan du mdog nyi zla/ mig dmar dmar po pad ma/ pa sangs sngon po shak+ti/ spen pa nag po rtse gsum/ khyab 'jug nag po 'khor lo thogs pa can/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na dbang po dkar/ tshangs pa ser/ drag po dkar ba phyag mtshan gdan 'dra ba/ 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhi/ me tog gi mda' lnga/ gzhu/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ thong pa can te stobs bzangs dkar po ral gri dang gshol/ gcer bu ste srin po nag po gri thod/ lha min thag bzangs ris nag po ral gri/ lha min stobs ldan nag po gri phub 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gus 'khyud pa ste/ gzhan sngar bzhin no/ /de nas rigs lnga'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang rang gi gdan dang mtshungs pa'i nyi zla la/ rang rang gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri las rang 'dra'i sku mtshon gang ba bsgoms pa'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'am sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa bsgoms la/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag ste/ rjes chags rdor sems kyi yan lag gnyis pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje se gol gyi sbyor bas sa bon las 'od 'phros/

rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes te/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun bsgrubs shing / /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje 'phen mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod de/ lcags kyu mas lcags kyus mdun du bkug zhags pa mas dkyil 'khor du bcug lcags sgrog mas lcags sgrog gis zhabs bcings/ dril bu mas dril bu dkrol bas dbang du byas te/ bdag nyid dang dbyer mi phyed par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ badz+ra bait+tā lī ban dha ya baṃ/ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shāṃ ku ru oḥ zhes brjod do/ /bsgrub pa'i yan lag go /de nas skye mched byin gyis brlabs te/ mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar ḍam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar sam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ lus la am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ yid la nam̐ las bdag med ma nag mo bsam/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje mkha' spyod ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje sa spyod ma sngon mo/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sa 'og spyod ma nag mo bsgom pa'o/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ pad nyi dang ro'i steng du skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'o/ /sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta khe tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā tā la wā si nī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ste/ nyer bsgrub kyi yan lag go

/de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig ma/ lha mo/ byang sems khro bo rnams ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od kyis spyan drangs la/ sngar ltar mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rjes bdag la brtsol/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po dang / /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub pa po/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ /ces bstod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha mo brgyad kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing / bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur bas/ lha kun gyi sku thams cad gang / chu thams cad yar lud pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum la mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga/ 'khor los sgyur ba bzhi la rnam snang / rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub/ lha mo rnams la shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhi dang / dbang ldan nas brtsams te mtshams bzhi rnams la/ mi bskyod pa/ rnam snang / rin 'byung / 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbur brgyan par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung ste/ de ni bsgrub pa chen po ste/ /dbang bskur ba mi skyod pa'i yan lag gsum pa'o/ /de nas nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a swāhās chang dang / de nyid mtheb srin gyis de nyid du gtor zhing / oṃ shrī hūm̐ ghuṃ dz+raṃ swā hās sha lnga sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/

raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed po gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ go ku da ha na/ bi ra shu ma mu/ yongs su gyur pa las phyogs bzhi dang dbus su/ ba lang / khyi/ rta/ glang po/ mi'i sha/ de dag gi steng du dri chen/ rak+ta/ khu ba/ sha chen gyi dngas ma/ dri chu bsam/ de dag gi steng du/ bh+rum̐/ am̐/ dz+rim̐/ kham̐/ hūm̐ gi yi ge sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bor bsgom/ de nas rlung g.yos me sbar bas gdungs pas/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ yi ge lnga dang bcas pa zhu ste/ nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ba'i khu ba'i sbu ba can gyi rlangs pa yongs su gyur pa'i hūm̐ nag po las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'bar ba zhu nas lan gsum lhung bas bdud rtsir song zhing / shel gyi rnam pa ltar gsal bar gyur pa las byung ba'i oṃ las skyes pa'i zla ba la gnas pa'i ā li kā li zhu ba las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge rim pas steng nas steng du gnas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs bskul te/ de rnams las bdud rtsi dang / rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa mtha' dag kyang bkug nas de la gzhug go /de nas yi ge gsum dang zla ba de nyid du thim par blta zhing / yig 'bru gsum gyis lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lha thams cad kyi lce la rdo rje nas 'bras tsam bsams te/ so so'i sngags brjod cing lha thams cad kyis bdud rtsi la longs spyod par bsams la/ mtheb srin sbyar ba'i rtses chang lce la gzhag ste/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swā da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de ni bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag bzhi pa'o/ /de nas thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' las lha mo brgyad spros pa las bdag nyid mchod par mos te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dzā badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ de ni mchod pa don grub kyi yan lag lnga pa'o/ /de nas lha mo rnams kyis bstod par mos te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ de ni bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag drug pa'o/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi snying kar/ zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsams te/ de las 'od 'phros pa lte ba'i aṃ la phog de me 'bar ba las sam/ snyoms par zhugs pas snying ka'i hūm̐ zhu nas yab yum gyi kun 'dar gyi sna rtser thig le yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam phab pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor shin tu phra ba bsgoms pa la/ yid rtse gcig tu gtad pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud 'od du zhu ste/ gzhal yas khang lha la bsdu/ lha thams cad rim gyis gtso bo yab yum gyi bar du bsdus la/ yab kyang yum la bsdu/ yum yang gsang ba'i thig le la/ de yang phyag mtshan la/ de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo nas yar rim pa bzhin phra mo'i sa bon gyi bar du rim pas bsdus/ sa bon yang nā da'i bar du bsdus/ de yang mi dmigs te stong par btang la/ de'i ngang la bzhag go /gsum pa bzlas pa ni/ stong pa las langs nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar rang rang gi gdan dang 'dra ba'i nyi zla'i steng du sa bon bsams te/ gtso bo'i sa bon las sngags phreng 'thon/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mar song / yum gyi zhal nas bdag gi zhal du bzhugs pa 'khor ba'i bzlas pa dang /

'khor rnams la thugs ka'i sa bon la sngags phreng gis bskor ba klog pa'i tshul du dmigs te/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ marda marda/ badz+ra dhṛ ka phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa ta/ e h+ye hi dzi na dzi ka phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sur+ya ta mo bi dha ma na sa ma ya satwaṃ/ a haṃ rat+na dh+ṝ ka phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma ya sa ma ya satwaṃ hu lu hu lu i ro lika phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥphuḥhi hi hi pradz+nyā dhṛka phaṭ swāhā/ yab lnga'i 'o/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ri ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥrat+na ra ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum lnga'i 'o/ oṃ āḥgau ri hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsau rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbait+tā li hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥghasma ri hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpuk+ka si hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsha ba ri hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṇ+ḍā li hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍoṃ bi ni hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lha mo rnams kyi mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ āḥsan+ta she hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpā shā+e ni hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsu gu ra hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ ku she hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpuṣ+pe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥdhu pe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥdī pe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥghan+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i lha mo rnams kyi mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ āḥsūr+ya haste hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥdī pe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥrat+na ā lo ke hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥta ḍit+ka re hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlā s+ye hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgī ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥnṛ ti hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhā s+ye hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i lha mo rnams kyi mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ āḥpad+me hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/

oṃ a dhar+m+mo/ da ye hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥs+pho ṭe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsh+le ṣe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ s+ye hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbī ṇe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmurdze hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsu ra dze hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ pad ma mkha' 'gro'i lha mo rnams kyi mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra tā le hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥkuñtsi ke hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥka pā ṭe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpa ṭa dhā ri ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlo tsa ne hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmā ma ki hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpa ra wā si ni hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtā re hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i lha mo rnams kyi mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ āḥ.aṃ ku she hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpā she hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥs+pho ṭe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sgo ma bzhi'i mtshan sngags so/ /gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dag pa dran pa/ mdun bskyed mchod pa/ zas/ spyod lam/ rjes chags/ nyal ba/ ldang ba/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni bsam gtan gyi dub na/ snying rje yi ni spyan dag dmar/ /spyan gyi rnam dag rdo rje gsum/ /zhal rnams rnam thar brgyad po yin/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug yin/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi pos ni/ /zhabs ni bzhi par brjod pa 'o/ /phyag rgya yis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /khro bo gdug pa 'dul ba po/ /bden pa rnam pa bzhi pos ni/ /rus pa ru ni yongs 'gyur pa'o/ /gzugs phung rdo rje ma ru 'gyur/ /tshor ba gsang ba'i gau rī ma/ /'du shes de bzhin chu ma ste/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes nyid ni bdag med ma/ /phung po don dam par na med/ /skye mched drug ni rnam dag phyir/ /de rnams yan lag drug tu 'gyur/ /zhe sdang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /chu ma ro yi rdo rje yin/ /phrag dog rdo rje gti mug ma/

/rdo rje rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ser sna gsang ba'i gau rī ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma'o/ /sa ni puk+ka si ru bshad/ /chu khams ri khrod ma ru brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes bya ste/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma rī yi gzugs/ /reg la sa spyod ma ru brjod/ /chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ /glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khong skam mdze dang rkang shu dang / /mchin pa mcher pa'i rang bzhin yang / /glang po la sogs rab tu grags/ /rdzi ma dpyi dang so nad dang / /mkhris pa khrag dang de bzhin rlung / /bad kan 'dzag dang lus gas dang / /skye sbab 'bras ni rma bya sogs/ /rkang rbam tshil nad rlig bkrangs dang / /sgyu ma 'phel dang lhog pa dang / /'khru dang rims nad rab 'gas ni/ /ka ran ta sogs rab tu grags/ /brjed byed dang ni pho mtshan lcags/ /chu bsri ba dang brdo chu dang / /gzhang nad bkran nad skres nad dang / /mig ser dom la sogs pa 'o/ /rlung dang mkhris pa ma zhu ba/ /sgribs g.yogs rab rib gcin bsri ba/ /gzhogs phyed na dang lkog 'bras dang / /rlung rgyas gza' lhag la sogs pa'o/ /lhag ma rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /bsdus pa ru ni bsam par bya/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis rnam dag dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mchod pa byin brlab/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa/ mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod rdzas rnams sngar bzhin bsang / sbyang / stong pa'i ngang pas/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dang zhing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' dang / bar snang thams cad khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par mos la/ rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo/

/gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi brten nam/ maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs nas/ sa bon tsam gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed do/ /gsum pa la/ phyi mchod/ /nang / bstod pa'i/ gtor ma'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la dbul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī/ oṃ ni rī hūm̐ khaṃ/ zhes pas/ khu tshur sbyar gung mo gnyis brkyang ba rtse sbyar ba'i phyag rgyas zhabs bsil dang / gzhan sngar 'dra ba las/ zhabs bsil gyi gnas su zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon zhes dang / ni ri ti la sogs pa'i gnas su/ badz+ra ni bi d+ye ā hūm̐ swāhā dang / sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭ dang / oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs kyis/ zhabs bsil zhal bsil 'thor 'thung / mchod yon rnams dbul/ me tog 'di rnams gtsang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces dang / ni ri ti'i gnas su/ puṣ+pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis me tog dbul ba'i tshul du gyen du 'thor ba'i phyag rgyas me tog dang / nags tshal las byung ro yi mchog /gang zhig dri yi bdug spos mchog /bdag gis zhes sogs dang / dhu pa dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis 'thur du ldugs pa'i tshul gyis bdug spos/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag gis zhes sogs/ ā lo ke dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis bzhibs te bsgrengs la mar me dbul ba'i tshul gyis mar me/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /shangs la tshim byed dag pa 'di/ /bdag gis zhes sogs/ gan+dhe dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brkyang bas rang gi snying gar dri byug pa'i tshul gyis dri dang /

lha bshos gtsang ma thams cad ni/ /bza' dang sbyar ba'i bye brag bcas/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /dbul gyis so sor bzhes su gsol/ /zhes dang / gan+dhe'i gnas su/ ku ru ku ru mahā bhak+ṣa shriṃ shriṃ swāhā/ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo brkyang ba mdun du gzhag pa'i tshul gyis lha bshos dang / sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /bdag gis zhes sogs/ ku ru ku ru'i gnas su shap+da/ zhes par rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyas par byed na/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rked par gzugs shing sgeg pa'i tshul dang / oṃ bha ga wān sngon du 'gro bas/ lā s+ya/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis mgo la phreng ba 'ching ba'i tshul dang / mā le/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis kha nas tshig dbyung ba'i tshul dang / gī ti/ thal mo 'gram pa gnyis dang spyi bor gzhag nas gar bskor ba dang / nṛ ti rnams kyis mchod/ gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ dang po bla ma/ de nas yi dam/ de nas chos skyong mkha' 'gro/ gzhi bdag gi bar mchod cing / so so'i mtshan dang sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul lo/ /gsum pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ sngar phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ gtor ma bdud rtsi myang ba'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ nam mkhar chos 'byung gi dbus su/ pad ma 'dab brgyad dang / lte ba la hūm̐ las phyogs skyong brgyad/ thugs rdo rje nag po/ steng du oṃ las pad ma 'dab brgyad la shar nas rim bzhin/ dbang phyug chen po/ dbang po/ tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug me nas/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag po/ bh+riṃ gi ri ti/ gzhon nu kīrti ka dbus su sku rdo rje la/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba thams cad kyang dkar po'o/ /'og tu pad+ma dmar po la āḥlas 'dab mar/ stobs kyi rgyu/ dung skyong / mtha' yas/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ rigs ldan/ pad ma/

pad chen/ dbus su gsung rdo rje la/ lha min dang ngan song gsum gyis bskor ba thams cad kyang dmar po'o/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi rig mas 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gis gnas par bsams la/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs par byas te/ dbang rtags su/ steng dbus/ 'og rnams la/ rnam snang / mi bskyod pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan pa'i lce la rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan ma'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ e h+ye hi ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī badz+ra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sa pa ri wā ra/ in+d+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhu ta/ bah+ni/ bā u/ ragakha/ tsan+d+ra/ pudz+dza/ ma da/ pa p+pa/ ta la pā tā laṃ/ aṣ+ṭa sa pa swāhā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñtsa/ dzi ghaṃ/ phul+la/ dhū pa/ māṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ am+bha/ kadz+dza/ sarba sā dha/ khān+ti khuṇi phe ḍa gā da/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ ār+ya nud pan na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam/ lngas dbul/ phyi nang yid byung gi mchod pas mchod la/ mi skyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang /
